newsitem.title: MOROCCO: SOCCER-CZECH REPUBLIC WIN DESPITE CONCEDING TWO PENALTIES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CZECH REPUBLIC WIN DESPITE CONCEDING TWO PENALTIES.

text.p: The Czech Republic conceded two penalties on their way to a 2-1 win over Nigeria in the opening game of the four-nation Hassan trophy in Casablanca on Wednesday.
The Czech Republic, runners-up in this year's European championship, took an early lead through Drulak Radek but had to wait until the 79th minute for their second goal from Hasek Martin.
Five minutes later the Nigerians, Olympic champions in Atlanta, missed the chance to pull back a goal when Czech goalkeeper Miklosko Ludek saved Ben Iroha's penalty.
Three minutes from time, however, the Nigerians were awarded another spot kick. Mobi Oparaku made no mistake this time .
